CustomField.description: Joins Salesforce Account to the corresponding Business Partner record in SAP S/4HANA. Populated either manually (legacy data) or via the nightly SAP Customer Master sync (SapCustomerMasterSyncService — ADR-027). External id with unique constraint so the upsert key is enforced at the DB layer. Production target: SAP BP is the master, SF Account fields are downstream mirror — sales reps edit Account only via "Request Customer Master Update" workflow that fires an SAP IDoc (per ADR-021 production target).
CustomField.label: SAP BP Number
